meta.title: Verification source registry
meta.policy: Only pages published by the National Football League or its official properties (nfl.com, operations.nfl.com) count as OFFICIAL. Every other source is recorded with official=false and can never be used to fill a table value; it may only be cited as an unverified lead.
meta.http_status_note: HTTP status recorded from the live fetch performed during this session.

sources.title: Competition Committee approves revisions to Injury Report
sources.check: Quoted the release verbatim: practice report = Did Not Participate / Limited Participation / Full Participation; game status = Out (will not play), Doubtful (unlikely), Questionable (uncertain); Probable eliminated because ~95% of Probable players played.

sources.title: If I place a bet on NFL.com or the NFL app, am I betting with the NFL?
supports: who supplies the odds shown in NFL surfaces
sources.check: Quoted verbatim: 'the NFL widgets show odds, spreads, and over/under number provided by official bookmaker partners of the NFL (FanDuel, Caesars, and DraftKings)... any bets placed would be through a redirect to the bookmaker's online sportsbook.'

irregularities.title: No NFL-authored betting lines; odds on NFL surfaces are partner-supplied
irregularities.detail: nfl.com/odds/ returns 404. NFL Support (S13) states that NFL widgets display odds, spreads and over/unders 'provided by official bookmaker partners of the NFL (FanDuel, Caesars, and DraftKings)', with bets placed through a redirect to the bookmaker. So odds do appear on NFL surfaces, but they are a licensed third-party feed, not an NFL product, and no historical, machine-readable line archive is published there.
irregularities.impact: Blocks every market-relative metric (CLV, ATS record, beating the close) from an official source. Model outputs are published as model-implied numbers, not as market lines.

irregularities.title: Guessed NFL Operations URLs return 404
irregularities.detail: Two plausible operations.nfl.com paths returned 'FLAG ON THE PLAY' 404s. Only the paths in S02 resolve.
irregularities.impact: None on data; recorded so no future session cites a dead link.

irregularities.title: Conflicting practice-squad size (16 vs 17)
irregularities.detail: S04 (nfl.com, official) states practice squads were increased to 16. A 2026 AP article surfaced in search describes 17 practice-squad players and 'six of the 17 can be veterans'. The AP page was not fetched directly, so its exact wording is unconfirmed.
irregularities.impact: Practice-squad size is left blank on the Rules page and marked unverified rather than guessed.
irregularities.action: F-02; requires an official 2026 league page (e.g. an NFL Football Operations roster-rules page or the 2026 CBA rules summary).
